snippet.title: Choco Kiosk Simulator | Short Gameplay
snippet.description:
Take a quick look at Choco Kiosk Simulator – a unique indie shop-management game where you run your own chocolate stand, serve quirky customers, manage your stock, and unlock new features as your business grows!

In this short gameplay video, you'll see how to:

- Restock shelves with various chocolate bars
- Serve customers and handle the cash register
- Upgrade your kiosk and complete daily tasks
- Keep your shop clean and deal with unexpected events

Wishlist Choco Kiosk Simulator on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3814130/Choco_Kiosk_Simulator/

Try the free demo, follow development, and join our Steam Discussions for the latest news and feedback!
